research_signals.signal: AI remains the strongest Science & Technology YouTube category in August 2026
research_signals.implication: Prioritize practical AI tools, workflows and comparisons rather than generic AI news.

research_signals.signal: Smartphone and gadget coverage remains commercially strong
research_signals.implication: Use launch-cycle explainers, comparisons, buying decisions and hands-on angles.

research_signals.signal: AI agents are moving toward longer autonomous workflows
research_signals.implication: Test practical 'AI agent that does X' tutorials and workflow demonstrations.

research_signals.signal: Creator audiences are showing sensitivity to undisclosed AI sponsorships
research_signals.implication: Use transparent sponsorship language and prioritize hands-on evidence over hype.

research_signals.signal: US audiences show growing concern about AI and jobs
research_signals.implication: US/global topics should include practical productivity, jobs, automation and limitations—not only hype.

research_signals.signal: Nepal is actively exploring AI for local-language preservation and translation
research_signals.implication: Nepal-specific AI, Nepali-language tools and local digital problems are differentiated opportunities.
